name: Topography
description: Slope, roughness, and local relief — primary safety and construction constraint.
landing_hard_cap_source: NASA Human Landing System terrain hazard threshold (Apollo operations ≤12°)

earth_variables.name: slope
earth_variables.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, resampled to 1 km

earth_variables.name: roughness
earth_variables.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 — std-dev of elevation in 3×3 km window

earth_variables.name: local_relief
earth_variables.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 — elevation range in 12 km neighborhood

moon_variables.name: roughness
moon_variables.source: LOLA DEM — std-dev of elevation in equivalent window

moon_variables.name: local_relief
moon_variables.source: LOLA DEM — elevation range in 12 km neighborhood

mars_variables.name: local_relief
mars_variables.source: MOLA/MOLA-HRSC — elevation range in 12 km neighborhood

name: Geology
description: Lithology and regolith analog — indicates construction material and surface chemistry.
class_mapping_note: GLiM class → Moon/Mars geologic class; mapping table maintained in preprocessing scripts.

moon_variables.name: geologic_unit
moon_variables.source: Unified Geologic Map of the Moon, USGS 1:5M

mars_variables.name: geologic_unit
mars_variables.source: USGS Global Geologic Map of Mars, Tanaka et al. 2014

name: Thermal
description: Temperature extremes and daily range — hardware stress and thermal management.
comparison_rule_note: Absolute temperatures cannot be reproduced on Earth. Scoring uses percentile rank of annual mean, range, and diurnal range across all Earth cells.

earth_variables.name: lst_annual_range
earth_variables.source: MODIS MOD11A2 — max minus min monthly mean

earth_variables.name: lst_diurnal_range
earth_variables.source: MODIS MOD11A2 — mean of (day LST − night LST)

mars_variables.name: temp_annual_mean
mars_variables.source: TES thermal data / Mars Climate Database

name: Aridity
description: Aridity and liquid-water absence — REQUIREMENT: score rewards proximity to maximum aridity.
comparison_rule_note: REQUIREMENT. Moon and Mars are maximally arid. Score = 1 − min(pr/pet, 1). Cells with permanent ice cover score 0.
moon_not_applicable_reason: Moon is maximally arid by definition; requirement score always = 1 for Moon targets.
mars_not_applicable_reason: Mars is maximally arid by definition; requirement score always = 1 for Mars targets.

name: Ice and Polar
description: Ground ice, permafrost, and polar light regime — in-situ water resource and polar environment.

moon_variables.name: illumination_fraction
moon_variables.source: LOLA polar illumination products — average illumination fraction

moon_variables.name: ice_detection
moon_variables.source: Lunar ice detection maps (combined LCROSS, LEND, Mini-RF)

name: Volcanic Terrain and Caves
description: Volcanic terrain and lava-tube proxy — natural shelter from radiation and thermal extremes.
proxy_note: No global open catalog of Earth lava tubes exists. Likelihood is estimated from GLiM vb class and distance to qualifying Holocene volcanoes. Validate against NASA Planetary Pits and Caves Analog Dataset.

proxy_likelihood_rules.HIGH: GLiM vb class present AND distance ≤ 50 km to qualifying Holocene volcano
proxy_likelihood_rules.MEDIUM: GLiM vb class present OR distance ≤ 100 km to qualifying Holocene volcano

earth_variables.name: distance_to_holocene_volcano
earth_variables.source: Smithsonian GVP Holocene volcanoes, filtered by type

name: Surface Optics
description: Albedo and dust — affects imaging, thermal balance, and surface operations.

earth_variables.name: broadband_albedo
earth_variables.source: MODIS MCD43A3 broadband shortwave albedo, annual mean

name: Illumination
description: Solar elevation regime — LOW SUN analog for lunar south pole; latitude-driven for Mars.
comparison_rule_note: Scores similarity to the target's solar-elevation regime. The lunar south-pole analog is a LOW SUN regime, not 'maximize illumination'.

earth_variables.name: max_solar_elevation
earth_variables.source: Computed from latitude (annual maximum solar elevation angle)

earth_variables.name: mean_solar_elevation
earth_variables.source: Computed from latitude (annual mean above horizon)

earth_variables.name: sun_fraction
earth_variables.source: Computed from latitude (fraction of year with sun above horizon)

moon_variables.name: illumination_fraction
moon_variables.source: LOLA polar illumination products — average illumination fraction

moon_variables.name: solar_elevation_range
moon_variables.source: Derived from orbital geometry at target latitude

mars_variables.name: illumination_fraction
mars_variables.source: Computed from Mars orbital parameters and target latitude

mars_weight_note: Illumination gets low default weight for Mars (excluded from mars-landing preset); seasonal dust variation is captured by surface_optics.
